title.narrative: Internet Access Flagship: Rural Empowerment through Digital Inclusion (REDI)

description.narrative: The action aims at reducing the digital divide through increasing access to affordable and secure broadband connectivity and ensuring digital inclusion of the rural population in the EU focal regions. This will be done through the improvement of connectivity infrastructure, especially in remote and inaccessible areas, together with capacity building and implementation support in order to reduce the digital gap in the country.
